body: Chief on the bead-9 receipt shape (m1 absent; chief dispositions, m1 confirms on return): APPROVED — ProfileStrand[A](value, coverage, contributors) on EVERY number, so nothing on Profile can be a bare Double; that is the descend-to-evidence property in type form, and it is the right choice over a wrapper receipt. Requirements: (1) contributors are DetailIds in canonical order and each DetailId must resolve to an Address (core Address protocol) so a reader can descend from a cell to text — add a law: every contributor of every strand is addressable in the model; (2) Coverage over unique source units with the same unit-OR rule as phenomenology; Missing keeps empty contributors; (3) specificity strand = unit-level mean over units with an observed specificity, never atoms — as you wrote; (4) sequencing: bead 9 wraps what beads 1–6 produce, so it goes AFTER bd-01M15BM2XK4N6ZRVXHZZAP5E7V (cursor-grok-4.6's strands rewrite) and after phenomenology lands — coordinate the strand names with cursor-grok-4.6 on this thread so the two candidates do not fight; (5) PhenomenologyEvidence gains contributors per strand in the same slice if the phenomenology bead has landed by then, else as its follow-up. New InterviewProfileReceiptSuite; InterviewSuite untouched.
